title: Vercel authentication repaired; protected staging HTTP acceptance verified
summary: All active root cached-token readers migrated to CLI-managed authentication. Protected HTTP 23/23, environment 47/47, local regressions 65/65, build, TypeScript and focused lint passed. Full staging and production remain NO-GO for documented browser, write-approval and release gates.

changes.detail: Eleven active root scripts use CLI-managed authentication, with JSON stdin, bounded in-memory output, origin/header guards and sanitized failures. Pinned historical source copies remain unchanged and must not be used as execution entrypoints.

Five meaningful transport/security regressions; new machine-readable release gate assessment and final acceptance report with source/configuration differences, migrations, backup/restore, rollback, indexing, security and monitoring requirements.

Acceptance evidence refreshed. Initial generated-types collision corrected by sequential validation. Temporary staging automation access used only for bounded HTTP acceptance and revoked; protection all retained.

validation.name: Focused local regressions
validation.detail: 24 operational tests plus 41 editorial/API/component/PGlite SQL/History tests passed. No hosted editorial/database writes. Five adapter tests also passed again after UTF-8 output handling refinement.

validation.name: Syntax and ESLint
validation.detail: All 12 operational scripts passed node --check; focused ESLint for scripts and new test passed.

validation.name: Hosted acceptance and isolation
validation.detail: 23 protected HTTP checks and 47 environment checks passed. Team/project/READY staging verified; production alias remains baseline. Two staging secrets are write-only; production secret bytes remain unverified.

validation.name: Production-mode build and TypeScript
validation.detail: Build exit 0 at 2026-10-21T10:32:31.834Z; sequential standalone types exit 0 at 2026-10-21T10:34:21.222Z. Initial TS6053 failure retained in related report. Existing lint warnings remain.

validation.name: Source and migration integrity
validation.detail: All 2123 pinned candidate files and six migration hashes match. Source delta against verified production baseline recorded; not certification of deployed bytes or an approved production upload set.

validation.name: Hosted browser and editorial writes
validation.detail: No browser surfaces; in-app browser unavailable. Hosted desktop/mobile, hydration, console/network, expired sessions, real editorial publish/rollback and cache invalidation remain unverified. Write approval, human FR/AR review, production bindings and recovery/release ownership still required.

validation.name: Production release
validation.detail: No deployment, production mutation, migration, push/merge or provider activation. Production and full staging remain NO-GO; HTTP acceptance alone is GO.
